sentences.text:
Shri Santosh Kumar Meena, learned counsel for the appell  Shri Sudeep Bhargava, learned Dy.A.G for the respondent/
Per Justice Gajendra Singh:
I.A.No.3690/2025 is the second repeat application under section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C, 1973/section 430 of the BNSS, 2023 for suspension of execution of sentence of the sole appellant.

The appellant has been convicted under section 366, 376(3) IPC r/w section 3 r/w section 4(2) of the POCSO Act, 2012, and section & 5(L) r/w section 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012 r/w section 376 (2)(n) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 5 years with fine of Rs.300/-, 20 years RI with fine of Rs.500/- and 20 years RI with fine of Rs.500/- respectively with further default stipulation.
The appellant has been convicted and sentenced for committing penetrative sexual assault against a child (PW/2) of 14 years age.

The first application was dismissed on 27.10.2023 as withdrawn and this second application is preferred on the ground that trial court did not consider very material and important contradiction and omission in the statement of prosecution witnesses.
The appellant is a permanent 2 CRA-8732-2023 resident of Dewas district and there is no apprehension of running away from the course of justice.
The trial court was wrong in discarding the defence version.

The application has been opposed by the State through reply filed earlier and adopted in this application also referring to para- 20,23,31,32,39,42 & 44 of the judgment.
There is a positive DNA finger print report (Ex.P/20) against the appellant.
Considering the statement of the victim (PW/2) and the DNA finger print report (Ex.P/20), we are not inclined to suspend the execution of sentence passed against the appellant at present.

(VIVEK RUSIA) (GAJENDRA SINGH  JUDGE JUDGE  hk/
